name: Agent Skill
headline: agent-skill for AI automation tasks
short_description: Agent-skill enables AI agents to search codebases using Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) patterns. It benefits developers and operations teams by allowing structural code search beyond simple text matching. The skill integrates with Claude Code plugin marketplace and is applied in code analysis, refactoring, and maintenance tasks.
author: ast-grep

sections.overview:
ast-grep agent skill teaches Claude Code how to write and use ast-grep rules to perform advanced structural code searches. Unlike traditional text-based search tools, ast-grep understands code structure, allowing you to find patterns like async functions without error handling, specific hook usage in React components, or console.log calls in class methods. The skill integrates with Claude Code plugin marketplace and works across multiple languages. Developers and operations teams benefit from more precise code analysis, refactoring, and maintenance tasks by searching based on code semantics rather than just text matching.
Find all async functions that do not implement error handling.
Locate React components that utilize a specific custom hook.
Identify functions with more than three parameters for potential refactoring.
Search for console.log calls within class methods to improve logging practices.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ast-grep/agent-skill`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
